question: The terms Mahari and Gotipua are associated with which Indian classical dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **terms Mahari and Gotipua are associated with the Indian classical dance form of Odissi**
 
• **Mahari**
 
 
• A** dancer who performed the Mahari Dance, which is the origin of Odissi.**
 
• **Maharis would sin**g verses from the Gita Govinda to please the divine trinity of Lord Jagannatha. 
 
 
 
• **Gotipua**
 
 
• A **young boy who was dressed as a female to perform the Gotipua dance, which originated as an offshoot of the Mahari tradition**.
 
• Gotipua is a traditional dance form in Odisha where young boys dress as women to praise Jagannath and Krishna. 
 
• **Odissi is one of the eight Indian Classical Dances **and is known for its storytelling through movement, expression, and rhythm.
 
• Many of its themes are drawn from Hindu mythology and folklore. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuchipudi**

 
 
• This **dance form is from Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.**
 
• It is **said to manifest earthly elements in the human body.**
 
• **Some famous proponents of this dance form include Radha Reddy and Raja Reddy, Yamini Krishnamurthy, and Indrani Rehman. **
 
 
 
• **Odissi**
 
 
• This dance **form is from Odisha.**
 
• **It is said to symbolize water.**
 
• Some famous proponents of this dance form include Guru Pankaj Charan Das, Kelu Charan Mohapatra, Sonal Mansingh, Sharon Lowen, and MYrla Barvie. 
 
 
 
• **Sattriya**
 
 
• This **dance form is from Assam.**
 
• It is **governed by strict principles for footwork, music, hasta mudras, and aharyas. **
